    New Colors
    Sport Band

    Custom high-performance fluoroelastomer with a pin‑and‑tuck closure.

    Made to push boundaries.

    Four styles designed for Apple Watch Ultra 3. Bands uniquely tailored for the demanding needs of all workout types, outdoor adventures, and ocean sports.

    New Colors
    Sport Loop

    Soft, lightweight nylon weave with an easily adjustable hook-and-loop fastener. Dense loops on the skin side provide soft cushioning and breathability.

    Stainless Steel

    Meticulously crafted steel designs for a sophisticated, upscale look.

    Nike Sport Band

    Compression-molded perforations for breathability. Color flakes make each band unique. A pin-and-tuck closure — carefully etched with the Run Swoosh logo — ensures a secure fit.

    Nike Sport Loop

    Quick-fastening, flexible nylon weave with reflective yarn.° A woven pull tab featuring the Run Swoosh logo makes it easy to adjust on the go.

    Only at Apple
    Solo Loop

    Stretchable liquid silicone rubber designed for ultracomfort with no buckles or clasps. footnote *

    Only at Apple
    Braided Solo Loop

    Stretchable yarn interwoven with silicone threads designed for ultracomfort with no buckles or clasps. footnote *

    FineWoven

    Made from a durable microtwill, this material has a subtle luster and a suedelike feel that’s soft against the skin.

    New Colors
    Hermès En Mer

    With a distinctive pillow stripe, a subtle “H” motif, and a secure titanium buckle, this two-tone, water-resistant band is suitable for all kinds of aquatic adventures.

    New Colors
    Hermès Scub’H Diving

    Molded from high-performance rubber, this sporty and striking band is lightweight and water resistant with circular porthole-like cutouts.

    Hermès Grand H

    Adjustable stainless steel links are bookended by the iconic “H” motif. Available in the classic Grand H style and the slimmer, more refined Grand H Fin.

    Hermès Faubourg Party

    This durable jacquard knit band features an illustration of Hermès’ iconic Faubourg Saint-Honoré store by artist Tibor Kárpáti.

    New
    Hermès Néo Tricot

    Inspired by Hermès sporting gloves from the 1930s, Néo Tricot is distinctively knitted in an openwork design that’s lightweight, breathable, and exceptionally comfortable.

    New
    Hermès Toile H Double Jeu

    Silky and water resistant, this bold, contrasting band puts a graphic spin on Hermès’ emblematic checked canvas.

    Hermès Toile H Single Tour

    A woven interpretation of Hermès’ signature checked canvas.

    New Colors
    Hermès Kilim Single Tour

    Sporty with a splash of sophistication — Kilim is made from waterproof molded rubber with a deployment buckle.
